WITH f AS (SELECT sale_date d, s.store_id sid, sum(net_amount) n, count(distinct receipt_id) r, sum(quantity) u FROM fact_sales_line x JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE channel_code='ST' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id sid, net_sales_before_returns n, receipts r, units_sold u FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30')
SELECT date_trunc('month', coalesce(f.d,r.d)) m, count(*) rows_, sum(CASE WHEN f.sid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_rpt, sum(CASE WHEN r.sid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_fact, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.n-r.n)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) netdiff, sum(f.n) fn, sum(r.n) rn, sum(CASE WHEN f.r<>r.r THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rdiff
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.d=r.d AND f.sid=r.sid GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT hour(sale_ts_utc) h, count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='ST' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', f.sale_date), '%Y-%m') AS month, sum(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-08-01' AND f.sale_date < DATE '2024-10-01'
